meta.curated.discoverability: Search-result description of the 'Discoverability' engineering note. Aim for roughly 110–160 characters in Latin scripts (fewer in CJK); it is shown whole in search results.
meta.composed: Fallback search-result description for an engineering note that has no curated one. {title} is the note's (translated) title, {n} its line count, already formatted.
note.partial: Notice above a translated engineering note when some of its paragraphs were edited recently and have not been re-translated yet, so they are shown in English.
note.crumbs.home: Breadcrumb name of the site's home page, published in structured data (search results). One word.
note.crumbs.notes: Breadcrumb name of the /notes index page (the engineering notes), published in structured data. One word, as the Notes page's own title.
